name: Rusty Sword
description: A battered sword, barely fit for battle. Better than nothing.
flavor_text: Every legend had a first weapon.

name: Iron Sword
description: A reliable iron sword. Standard military issue.

name: Mage's Staff
description: A gnarled wooden staff capped with a mana crystal. Focuses magical energy.
flavor_text: Wood remembers what it once was: alive.

name: Enchanted Blade
description: A sword humming with contained magical energy. In the right hands, the boundary between sword and spell dissolves.
flavor_text: The runes were carved by someone who understood both arts.

name: Shadow Daggers
description: Twin daggers that seem to absorb light. They strike before the eye can track them.
flavor_text: Speed is the only armor a rogue needs.

name: Mage's Wand
description: A slender wand carved from void-touched wood. Channels arcane energy with unusual efficiency.
flavor_text: The wood still hums with borrowed power.
backstory: Cut from a tree that grew through a sealed Fracture rift. The System classifies it as an anomalous implement — catalogued but not understood.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: A blade that seems to absorb light. Strikes faster than the eye can track.
backstory: Recovered from the body of a Void-Walker during the third purge. The System's classification is simply: DANGEROUS. RETAIN FOR STUDY.

name: Rusty Dagger
description: A short blade, poorly maintained but functional.
backstory: Found in every beggar's boot in Verath.

name: Short Bow
description: Standard issue for scouts and hunters.
backstory: The Adventurers' Guild keeps a stockpile of these for new Rangers.

name: Apprentice Staff
description: A simple wooden staff imbued with minor mana conductivity.
backstory: The Mages Conclave hands these out at classification. Many end up in the dungeon.
